thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and request timeouts observed in /v1/generate (us-east-1). p95 increased from 120ms -> 2.1s, p99 -> 6.3s. Error rate 5xx 8% over last 5m. Canary deploy at 1751239500. Paging on-call: @emma_oncall :rotating_light:

alex_chu: seeing the bot alerts — is this the canary we pushed 10m ago?

release-engineer: yep, canary release v2025.3.7 rolled to 5% of traffic at 1751239500. No backend infra changes.

maria_v: confirmed spikes on the canary hosts. p99s climbing specifically for sequences >512 tokens. Could be a new attention kernel fallback.

jordan_sre: running quick checks. grabbing logs from canary pods now. ``kubectl logs -l app=inference,rev=canary --tail 200``

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: v2025.3.7 -> 5% traffic at 1751239500 by @release-engineer. No rollout errors reported.

alex_chu: @jordan_sre paste the top 10 stack traces if you see timeouts or retry storms.

jordan_sre: logs show repeated kv-cache misses + long GC pauses in the runtime process on 2/5 canary hosts. snippet: 
``[2025-06-12T14:12:23Z] ERROR runtime: request timeout after 15s, backend latency=12.8s, kv-cache-miss=true, model=redwood-2.1-q4
[2025-06-12T14:12:24Z] WARN runtime: batch size=1, fallback serialized attention kernel: slow path
```

maria_v: that matches my traces — falling back to slow attn for longer contexts. Could be a kernel selection regression introduced in the model packaging step.

emma_oncall: I'm on it. Initiating mitigation: reduce canary traffic to 0% and roll back canary. Who has permission to cut traffic?

release-engineer: I can. Running traffic shift: `redwoodctl rollout set-traffic v2025.3.7=0% --route /v1/generate`

deploy-bot: Action started: adjusting traffic weights.

jordan_sre: also starting a temporary routing rule to send canary traffic to fallback cluster in the same region. `rtrctl route set /v1/generate --to cluster=canary-fallback`

alex_chu: @release-engineer add a rollback command as well in case traffic shift doesn't help. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=24`

release-engineer: rollback queued. Executing now.

release-engineer: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=24` -> started.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident created PD-7891, severity=page, responders=@oncall, @sre.

customer-ops: any initial estimate of customer impact? Are requests getting 5xx or timeouts?

jordan_sre: both. 5xx rate peaked at 8% overall but for affected customers hitting long contexts it's closer to 22%. Error types: 502 gateway, 504 upstream timeout, 500 runtime exception.

maria_v: throttles triggered in Redwood Console for a few high-traffic routes. Observed fallback invocations spiking.

emma_oncall: rollback is in progress. I'll monitor metrics. Can someone dump the metric chart link?

jordan_sre: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/d/serving/latency?org=infra&range=15m (paste)

alex_chu: timeline: canary at 1751239500, alert at 1751239999, mitigation traffic shift at 1751240100, rollback started at 1751240205.

jordan_sre: rollback finished on 4/5 replicas; one pod stuck terminating, I exec'd in and saw a hung runtime process. forcing delete now. `kubectl delete pod inference-canary-3 --grace-period=0 --force`

release-engineer: pods reconverged. Canaries at 0% traffic.

incident-bot: UPDATE: p95 returned toward baseline (150ms) within 4 minutes of traffic shift; p99 trending down from 6.3s -> 460ms over 8 minutes. 5xx rate dropped to 0.6%.

customer-ops: we'll open a customer-facing note. Any known customers impacted? list: AcmeCo, NimbusAI, EdgeScribe. Estimated window ~14:12:23 - 14:20:30 UTC.

maria_v: capturing artifacts for postmortem: model packaging diff, kernel selection logs, and per-host telemetry. I'll tag the commit: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> `a7c4d2b`

alex_chu: good. We should lock the model packaging pipeline until we triage. @release-engineer add a temporary gating check.

release-engineer: added gating flag: `--require-kernel-smoke-test` to pipeline and disabled auto-promote to canary for now.

emma_oncall: handing off to follow-up SREs for deep triage. @jordan_sre can you own the next 2 hours? I'll update PD and notify customers.

jordan_sre: taking handoff. I'll collect heap profiles, kernel selection traces, and reproduce locally with longer contexts.

incident-bot: ACTION ITEMS: (1) postmortem assigned to @maria_v, (2) rollback verification noted, (3) customer comms draft by @customer-ops, (4) pipeline gate added by @release-engineer.

alex_chu: thumbs up. Add follow-up: consider adding a short synthetic test for sequences >512 in canary smoke suite.

emma_oncall: ack. closing pager for now as metrics normalized, PD severity downgraded to incident-response. I'll leave the thread open for triage updates. :white_check_mark:
